issue.title: [AEGIS] Command injection via host in /ping
issue.body:
## Summary
- Severity: ERROR · Rule: `aegis.py-subprocess-shell-true` · CWE: CWE-78
- Location: `app.py:41-42` @ a3f1c2d
- Seen before across the fleet: 2 · Repo MTTR: n/a h
## What is wrong
The `cmd` query parameter from the request is concatenated into a shell command and run with `subprocess.run(..., shell=True)`, so any user can execute arbitrary commands on the host.
## Impact
Remote command execution as the web server user.
## Recommended fix
```python
subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", host], shell=False)
```
## Evidence
```
cmd = "ping -c 1 " + request.args.get("host")
subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)
```
Semgrep: subprocess call with shell=True and user input
